summary: Tested 3 new HSE/HR forms (Near Miss QMSF 32, Training Appraisal QMSF 08, Leave of Absence QMSF 12) backend + frontend and PHC Risk Heatmap. All 10 backend pytest tests PASSED (reference endpoints, auto-incrementing counters, full CRUD with persistence checks, stats, auth required, default Pending status/date_of_request). Frontend: heatmap renders all 25 cells with correct data-testid grid (phc-heatmap-c<1-5>-l<A-E>); after creating a PHC with hazards (c=5,l=C) and (c=2,l=B), the matching cells correctly showed count=1 while all others remained 0, and after delete they reset to 0. Forms register pages (nm-page, ta-page, loa-page), QMSF badges, 4 stat cards each, Print Blank Form (window.open triggered), New Report flow, fill+save with auto-prefix (NM-001/TA-001/LOA-001 style), edit, and print all work. Test data cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='nm-status' on status <select> inside form — review request expected to assert status change
Delete button on register row has no data-testid (e.g., nm-delete-<id>) — request mentioned deleting record
Delete button on register row has no data-testid='ta-delete-<id>'
Delete button on register row has no data-testid='loa-delete-<id>'

issues: Mixed-content console errors: axios calls to /api/settings/ hit http:// instead of https:// — pre-existing in app, not in scope of this iteration but worth flagging in settings axios client

action_items: Add data-testid='nm-status' to status <select> in Near Miss form (NearMissRegister.js)
Add data-testid='nm-delete-<id>' / 'ta-delete-<id>' / 'loa-delete-<id>' to row Trash2 buttons for automated coverage
(Optional) Fix mixed-content http -> https for /api/settings call in the global axios client — affects all pages console noise
critical_code_review_comments: Counter collection 'ncr_counters' is shared across NCR, NM, TA, LOA, PHC etc — this is fine because each uses a unique _id key (near_miss_no/training_appraisal_no/loa_no), but consider renaming to a neutral name like 'sequence_counters' for clarity.

All three new routers correctly: use uuid.uuid4() ids, project out _id from queries, use timezone-aware UTC ISO timestamps, validate via Pydantic, and gate every endpoint behind get_current_user. Good practice.
training_appraisal stats total_hours aggregation handles None correctly via 'or 0'.
Leave of Absence sets date_of_request to today only when missing — good default behavior.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (heatmap + all 3 form registers/forms/print/save/edit verified; row-delete testids absent but delete functionally works via Trash2 button + confirm)

seed_data_creation: Test records created and deleted within tests (TEST_NM, TEST_TA, TEST_LOA prefixed). PHC test record also created & deleted. Stats baseline restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest test_new_safety_hr_forms.py covers all 3 new modules. PHC heatmap verified by creating a PHC via API with hazards (c=5,l=C) and (c=2,l=B), reloading page, asserting [data-testid=phc-heatmap-c5-lC]=1 and c2-lB=1, then deleting. window.open print stubs must include document.open in the stub: returning { document: { open:()=>{}, write:()=>{}, close:()=>{} } } — the printOne helper calls w.document.open() and crashes on a bare stub. Note: localStorage token key is 'token' (or 'access_token') — verify before reusing in browser.
rca_notes: No bugs requiring fix — all features working. Only testability gaps (a few missing data-testid on inline action buttons and status select) noted as action items.
